objective: Decision 0097, the rules: Perfect timing, combos, the shield, stars and star chests.
acceptance_criteria: A tap PERFECT_AT after the meter fills is a Perfect power attack
Power attacks by different animals in quick succession make a combo
The shield halves enemy power attacks, with a cooldown
A won wave gives up to three stars, kept per wave, and a star chest every 15 stars
verification: Lune 754/754, selene clean. Studio, local build, stamp `dev`, 2026-11-19: wave 1 won with 2 of 3 stars (10.2 s against a 10.0 s target), stars saved per wave; a tap as the ring closed gave PERFECT!; a second animal's power within 3 s gave COMBO x2; the shield pressed in the warning window gave BLOCKED! with a 6 s cooldown.
